name: recv-file-short-frame-panic
title: recv_file panic: empty/short device WRTE frame underflows payload[len-8..] slice (remote-triggerable)
description: adb_session.rs:113-115 slices payload[(len-8)..(len-4)] with no length guard; a valid 0-byte device WRTE frame underflows usize and panics the task. Guard with payload.len()<8 -> structured error / payload.get(...). Verified by architecture review finding #4.
creator: magicdian
